name: Tavily

test_list.description: Map the documented Tavily response fields to the SDK contract.
Map 401/403 and 429 responses to sanitized SDK errors and apply Retry-After.
The key is sent only in the documented authentication header and never included in diagnostics.
Only the redactor output is included in the outgoing request.
Reject non-HTTPS remote bases; permit HTTP only for explicit loopback fixtures.
Reject malformed site filters without recording the HTTP call as dispatched.
Bound response count and duration and support cancellation.

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: Configured base URL, injected API key, timeout, and limiter.

inputs.name: redactor
inputs.description: SDK redactor applied before query data leaves the process.

output_description: A real Tavily search adapter returning SDK SearchHit values.
